title: Regular constant scalars act monomorphically on flat module sheaves
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site, $A$ a commutative ring, and $A_{\mathcal C}$ the constant ring sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Let $M$ be a sheaf of $A_{\mathcal C}$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] that is flat [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules]. Fix $a\in A$ such that the function $A\to A$, $x\mapsto ax$, is injective. Then multiplication by the constant scalar $a$ is a monomorphism on both $A_{\mathcal C}$ and $M$. Explicitly, for every object $U$ of $\mathcal C$ the maps $A_{\mathcal C}(U)\to A_{\mathcal C}(U)$ and $M(U)\to M(U)$ given by $s\mapsto as$ are injective. Neither a domain hypothesis on $A$ nor an enough-points hypothesis on $\mathcal C$ is required.

source.place: Tag 03EI (lemma-sheafification-exact), applied to the constant ring presheaf A, followed by Tag 03ER (definition-flat), sheaf clause (3). The constant-module tensor-unit identification is in section-tensor-product.

proof.text: Let B=A[1/a]. Regularity of a implies regularity of every power, so A→B is injective by [lem-pc-affine-localization-injective]. The associated map of constant presheaves of commutative rings is monic. The assumed HasSheafify J CommRingCat means precisely that its sheafification preserves finite limits, hence monomorphisms. Evaluation and forgetting rings preserve pullbacks, so the resulting map of ring sheaves is injective on each object. Naturality of the sheafification unit identifies the image of the constant section η(a) with the image in the constant B-sheaf of a/1, which is a unit. Cancellation after this injection proves that multiplication by η(a) is injective on the constant A-sheaf. This uses the given left exact ring sheafification directly, without identifying it with abelian sheafification.

Write R for the constant ring sheaf. If η(a)s=η(a)t in M(U), apply [lem-weil-pbc-flat-local-relations-universes] to the single relation η(a)(s-t)=0. On a covering sieve S, it gives finitely many sections z_j and coefficients b_j with (s-t)|V=Σ_j b_j z_j and (η(a)|V)b_j=0. The naturality of the constant-sheaf unit identifies η(a)|V with η_V(a). Step 1 therefore makes every b_j zero, and (s-t)|V=0 for every arrow in S.

The underlying abelian presheaf of the module sheaf M is a sheaf [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], hence separated. Vanishing of s-t on the covering sieve S implies s-t=0, so s=t. Together with Step 1 this proves the two sectionwise injectivity assertions, including empty covers and the zero ring. This is a below-unit shorter route; the integral-model unit and its parent scalar resolution are unchanged.
